blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A performance review is a meeting. The manager and the employee sit together and talk about work.

They talk about the good things and the things that can improve. It is a moment to say "Well done", and also a moment to plan for the future.

A good review is calm, clear and honest. Both people listen and both people speak.

items.q: What is a performance review?
items.why: "A performance review is a meeting… and talk about work."

items.q: Who sits together in the review?
items.why: "The manager and the employee sit together."

items.q: According to the text, a good review is…
items.why: "A good review is calm, clear and honest."

items.q: The text says "Both people listen and both people speak." This suggests that a review is…
items.why: Inferência: se os dois ouvem e os dois falam, é uma conversa de mão dupla.

items.q: Which idea would the author most likely AGREE with?
options: The manager should shout at the employee.
A review should feel calm, not scary.
A review is only about mistakes.
items.why: Inferência: o texto valoriza um clima calmo e honesto, e fala de coisas boas também — não só erros.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie na reunião de avaliação com Lucas. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi Lucas, thank you for coming. Please sit down. This is your review for the last three months. It is a calm meeting, so please relax.

First, the good news. Your work is strong. You are fast and you help the team every day. When a client has a problem, you answer quickly. That is a real strength. Well done.

Now, one thing to improve. Sometimes you start many tasks, but you do not finish all of them. Next month, I want you to finish one task before you start a new one. That is a small goal, and I know you can do it.

So, I have two questions for you. Do you enjoy your work here? And do you have a goal for the future? Take your time. We can talk about your plan together. Feedback is not only from me to you — I also want to listen to you.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is this meeting about?
options: Lucas's review for the last three months
items.why: "This is your review for the last three months."

items.q: What good thing does Sophie say about Lucas?
options: He is fast and helps the team
items.why: "You are fast and you help the team every day."

items.q: What does Sophie want Lucas to improve?
options: To finish one task before starting a new one
items.why: "finish one task before you start a new one."

items.q: Sophie says "Feedback is not only from me to you." This suggests that she…
options: does not want Lucas to speak
items.why: Inferência: ela também quer ouvir o Lucas — é uma conversa nos dois sentidos.

items.q: How does Sophie sound in this meeting?
items.why: Inferência: ela pede para relaxar, elogia e propõe uma meta pequena — o tom é calmo e gentil.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Her performance this month was very good." Performance means…
options: how well you do your work
items.why: Performance = desempenho: o quão bem você faz o trabalho.

items.q: "Speaking is my strength, but writing is not." A strength is…
items.why: Strength = ponto forte: algo que você faz bem.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I want to ___ my English, so I study every day."
items.why: Improve = melhorar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "My ___ for this year is to lead a new project."
items.why: Goal = meta: o que você quer alcançar.

items.q: "Please give me honest feedback." Honest means…
items.why: Honest = honesto: verdadeiro e aberto.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões de avaliação. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Well done on the report, Lucas!" Well done means…
items.why: Well done = muito bem, bom trabalho.

items.q: "You need to follow up with the client tomorrow." To follow up means to…
options: check again or continue the contact
items.why: Follow up = retomar o contato, dar continuidade.

items.q: "Let's go over your goals for next month." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, passar por algo juntos.

items.q: "You are doing great. Keep it up!" Keep it up means…
items.why: Keep it up = continue assim, mantenha o bom trabalho.

items.q: "I want to work on my weak points." To work on something means to…
items.why: Work on = trabalhar em algo para melhorá-lo.
